notes.title: Patch 1.03 - Teleport, In-Game Menu, Improved Red dots etc
notes.content:
New features

- Allow teleport before shooting started.  Have the laser pointed to the ground, press the trigger button to teleport.

- Press menu button to open the in-game menu.  You can now click next, restart, go to main menu or quit DrillsVR using the in-game menu.

- Improved Red dot sights.  In the in-game menu, you can choose whether your red dot sights will be the left eye or right eye zero'ed.

-  New languages.   Language will have defaulted to your Windows language.  However, you can choose another language in the main menu.   More new languages will come.

- other minor bug fixes included.

notes.title: Free New Tutorial! And Oculus Rift Fixes
notes.content:
Tutorial
A new interactive tutorial is added.  You can access it via the Tutorial button in the main menu.  It is an interactive step by step guide to introduce you how Competitve Shooting and DrillsVR control works.  Currenly English and Cantonese are available, more languages will be added later.

Oculus Rift
We have adjusted the angle of weapons for Rift’s touch controls.  At the same time, Practise Lobby, Starting vol and Short courses are re-created to avoid the use of a third sensor.  Please feel free to try it out and let us know if there is further issue for you.  Thanks you all for the patience.

Info@drillsVR.com

notes.title: Free - Small Area Pack
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32854040/0e5c646912838253def2214af4a6c899cd266c81.jpg[/img]

We recently got feedbacks saying the courses DrillsVR designed is larger than the play area they have set up.   To continue improving DrillsVR and also get the VR competitive shooting to more people.  We created another free pack named "Standing Courses Vol 1".   This stage pack consists of 5 new stages that require less than 1.5x 1.5 meter space.   Hope you would enjoy them.

The stages are stored in our cloud.  Without additional download, you can access it by clicking the right arrow in the main menu.  

Enjoy,
Team B Laboratory

notes.title: Oculus Rift Issue
notes.content:
We are fully aware of the Oculus Rift touch controller issue while running DrillsVR.

We are dedicted and in progress to fix the issue with Rift.  Please allow a week or two for a fix.  Further announcements will be made.  Thanks for the patience and sorry for the inconvinience caused.

Meanwhile, HTC vive and Windows WMR are tested and fully supported.  Please continue to probide feedbacks and are well appreciated.  Thanks very much for playing DrillsVR and hope we will see each others in a real shooting range.

Team B laboratory

notes.title: Welcome to DrillsVR
notes.content:
Welcome to the DrillsVR.  We are glad to say that we have officially launch DrillsVR on release today.  There are two video tutorials in the game when you run it in your VR headset.   There is also a practise lobby for you to try out different firearms to warm yourself up.

We have included 15 stages in 3 packages (Starting, Short courses and long courses vol 1)   Starting will be the place where you start on Practical Shooting yet simplified the simulation.  You have unlimited ammo in your magazine and you can focus on shooting.   Short courses and Long courses will be more realistic simulation.  We will continue to add more packages from time to time.

What we say release is that we would like to share you the work we have done.  However, that’s not the final product.  We greatly appreciated if you can provide us any feedback and we can continue to enhence the simulation experience today.  Hope you would love DrillsVR and see you on a real shooting range one day.

Enjoy
Team B Laboratory
